model_version: 2025 xteNCAM assessment under the 2023 framework; detailed report published as DFO Research Document 2026/026
notes: 2025 production xteNCAM assessment under the 2023 framework; the detailed Research Document was published in April 2026. Fitted inputs end in 2024, while selected population estimates extend through 2025. Inputs remain partial because exact numerical Capelin covariate values and detailed tag release/return/reporting-rate observations are not represented; Smith Sound sample ages 15-16 also lack a documented mapping to model age 14. Outputs remain partial because numerical age-specific population and mortality surfaces are not tabulated in the report.

Detailed 2019 SCA assessment through 2018 under the 2012 framework. DFO 2024/026 says the last full assessment was completed in 2019; the 2024 summary and 2024/053 rebuilding document are not entered as a separate assessment and none of their estimates are mixed into this run. Inputs remain partial: Table 1 stock catches are represented for 1965-2018, but the model spans 1950-2018; Table 3 landed numbers-at-age (1971-2018) do not provide the full reported fitted catch compositions, and the fitted survey series and age compositions are not fully represented. Outputs remain partial because age-specific M and several fitted observation series are not numerically tabulated.
